notes:
Account: large North American retail analytics provider; highly sensitive PII and regional pricing data. Short summary:
- Primary ask: Dedicated capacity evaluation for low-latency personalization + reranking. Interested in guaranteed throughput and strict tenant isolation.
- Technical wishlist recapped from call: 99.95% uptime SLA, p95 chat latency < 200ms, p99 < 400ms for N=512 token contexts, support for burst windows up to 600 RPS for embeddings pipeline.
- Traffic shaping requirements: want "priority lanes" for customer-facing routes (checkout personalization) labeled Gold/Silver/Bronze. Gold: guaranteed minimum qps, preemptible burst credit; Silver: best-effort with soft quotas; Bronze: batch/async only.
- Noisy-neighbor concerns: want per-tenant per-route token/sec quotas, dynamic circuit breaker, and automatic throttling isolated to tenant pools (avoid spillover into high-priority lanes).
- Reserved GPU planning: initial ask 16 x A100 across two availability zones (primary + failover region). Need guidance on sizing for mixed workloads (chat + reranking + embeddings) and expected tail latencies under concurrent sessions.
- Fallback expectations: if Dedicated capacity saturated, automatic fallback to Redwood hosted API for non-PII routes; on-Prem/VPC routes must never leak to hosted.
- Compliance: strict data residency in NA; audit logs retained 1 year; KMS integration mandatory.
- Commercial: pref commit model vs hybrid (commit + overage). Finance asking for ARR estimate and uplift for 99.95% SLA.
- Quote from VP Eng: "We need predictability at peak shopping windows — we can't have noisy spikes from research batches bringing checkout to its knees."
- Internal thread refs: security already started a SOC2 checklist; legal requested sample SLA and data flow diagrams.
